title: Sr Technical Consultant - Shift Lead (Apple Devices Tenant Migration)
tagsAndSkills: jamf,conditional access,ai,employee referral,endpoint management,bonds,microsoft security,mac os
jobDescription:
Job Summary

As a Senior Technical Consultant (Shift Lead) within the Devices Factory, you will serve as the on-shift technical authority for high-volume device migrations between Microsoft 365 tenants for a global multi-entity enterprise. You will lead execution across a 24x7 factory model, coordinating repeatable, runbook driven waves of Mac OS device transition, Kandji/IRU or Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) / Platform Single Sign-On (PSSO) activities. You will be accountable for shift readiness (tooling, access, queues), quality gates, evidence capture and rapid issue resolution so that device migrations are delivered safely, predictably and at programme scale. This is a hands-on migration execution, technical leadership role: you will still troubleshoot complex device migration failures, but your primary success measure is consistent throughput with low rework and disciplined shift operations.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical delivery of device migration waves during your shift, ensuring operational control, adherence to runbooks and predictable throughput.
  • Own shift level triage for device migration failures (Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) registration, enrolment, compliance, conditional access, certificate/device identity issues) and coordinate rapid remediation.
  • Validate pre req readiness (device inventory, hardware hash readiness, targeting, Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) profile assignment, migration scheduling) and enforce go/no go criteria.
  • Oversee execution of tenant transition steps for Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) where applicable (collection of hashes, deregistration/deletion sequencing, re registration timing, end user reset/re provisioning coordination).
  • Manage the shift backlog in the agreed ticketing system; prioritise work items by risk, SLA and cutover schedule.
  • Drive strong evidence capture: logs, screenshots, reports, change records and acceptance artefacts aligned to audit and client governance needs.
  • Coordinate shift handover packs (work completed, exceptions, blockers, next actions, risk list) and ensure continuity across the three shift model.
  • Partner with the Devices Solution Architect / discipline lead to update runbooks, troubleshooting guides and standard operating procedures based on real shift learnings.
  • Engage vendor/tool support channels as required (e.g., Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) / Kandji/IRU / Jamf escalation paths, migration tooling vendors where used), ensuring timely escalations with complete evidence.
  • Lead post migration validation checks and hypercare support for device cohorts; reduce repeat incidents through root cause removal and runbook improvements.

Qualifications

Must Have (or equivalent experience):

  • Delivered at least one production M365 tenant to tenant device migration as a technical lead/SME, specifically covering Mac OS device transition and endpoint management between tenants.
  • Strong hands on expertise with Jamf, Kandji/IRU, Mac OS provisioning, device compliance policies, configuration profiles and troubleshooting enrolment failures.
  • Hands on experience with Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) (device registration concepts, profile assignment, re provisioning) and practical migration sequencing across tenants.
  • Competence in Platform Single Sign-On (PSSO) and how these affect access, compliance and conditional access behaviour.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in a runbook first factory model: strict execution steps, peer checking/quality gates and disciplined closure criteria.
  • Proven experience working shift-based delivery with mandatory handovers, queue management and accountability for shift outcomes in a 24x7 environment.
  • Strong PowerShell and Mac OS specific automation capability for device readiness and operational scripting (inventory validation, hash collection, reporting, bulk actions), with safe change practices.
  • Strong documentation discipline: ability to produce and maintain clear SOPs, troubleshooting playbooks and evidence packs per migration wave.

Good to Have:

title: Data Scientist 2
jobDescription:
Data Scientist - 2 (DS-2)

Job family: Data Science
Level: DS-2 (equivalent to MLE-2 / AIE-2)
Scope of impact: Feature
Theme: Grows and Acts completes scoped modelling tasks and
improves team process

Why this role exists

Product outcomes need deep problem ownership and tight iteration
with PMs and product engineering. A DS-2 turns a scoped product
problem into a calibrated model or decision system, ships it
through the standard production path, and owns its performance
after launch. You operate with minimal guidance on a defined
feature, not the whole domain.

What you own

- A scoped modelling problem framed as a DS task: hypothesis,
success metric, offline and online evaluation plan.
- Calibrated predictive or causal models with well-behaved
probabilities and effect estimates.
- Repeatable pipelines integrated with production workflows, not
one-off notebooks.
- Basic model monitoring for the features you ship.
- Post-launch performance of your model and its link to the
target KPI; iterate using telemetry.

What you do not own (yet)

- Platform uptime and shared serving infrastructure (ML
Engineering owns this).
- Domain-wide priority setting across multiple initiatives (DS-3
and above).

What youll do (proficiency expectations at L2)

Data-driven decision making
- Build calibrated predictive or causal models with sound
probability and effect estimates.
- Articulate the impact of uncertainty and select an applicable
course of action with minimal guidance.
- Stress-test findings with simple mental models or simulations
before trusting them.

Technical expertise
- Set up fully reproducible environments for your own work and
share the guides with peers.
- Package work into repeatable pipelines and integrate them with
production workflows.
- Implement basic model monitoring.

Applied ML/AI/DS
- Frame and scope an opportunity as a DS problem, and pick the
right solution family (prediction, optimization, causal).
- Review recent literature, build reproducible pipelines, and
fairly compare alternative models.
- Run controlled pilots that connect model uplift to a target
KPI.

Experimentation and inference
- Frame a testable hypothesis and pick the right design (A/B or
hold-out).
- Run multi-metric or stratified tests with power checks and
CUPED variance reduction.
- Conclude using confidence intervals, state the limitations,
and tie results back to a target KPI.

Strategy and influence
- Scope an opportunity into a well-posed DS problem, naming the
RoI and the product and process changes it implies.
- Align stakeholders on the KPI leverage of a proposed approach
and secure agreement on scope and goals.
- Coordinate with engineering and product leads to launch
features where the model provides core value; shape planning and
risk assessment.

How you work with others

- PM: co-own the outcome and prioritisation for your feature.
- Product Engineering: integrate your model into customer-facing
experiences.
- ML Engineering / AI Engineering: consume platform primitives;
collaborate on evaluation, reliability gates, and production
readiness.

What we expect from a strong DS-2

- Ships production artifacts on the standard path, not
prototypes that stall at the production boundary.
- Improves at least one team process (templates, reviews,
reproducibility) beyond their own tasks.
- Owns outcome integrity: model outcomes stay aligned with
product outcomes after launch.

jobDescription:
Hello, We are Hiring Partnership Manager API & Strategic Partnerships at Link Publishers Pvt. Ltd

Experience: 3 5 Years
Department: Sales & Partnerships
Location: Ahmedabad
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a Partnership Manager API & Strategic Partnerships who can identify and build partnerships with SEO products, SaaS platforms, agencies, and other digital marketing businesses.

The primary responsibility of this role is to identify companies where the Link Publishers API can be integrated into their existing product or where our platform can be offered as a white-label link-building solution under the partners own brand.

This is not a traditional sales role focused on mass cold outreach. We are looking for someone who can research a product, understand how it works, identify where Link Publishers fits into its ecosystem, and then approach the right decision-maker with a personalized partnership proposition.

Key Responsibilities 1. Identify API Partnership Opportunities

Research and identify SEO tools, SaaS products, marketing platforms, backlink tools, content platforms, AI SEO tools, agency software, and other relevant products where the Link Publishers API can add value.

You will be expected to:

1/ Understand what the target product does and who its customers are.
2/ Explore the product, website, features, pricing, and existing integrations.
3/ Identify where link-building capabilities can fit naturally into the product.
4/ Develop a clear use case for integrating the Link Publishers API.
5/ Identify the right companies based on partnership potential rather than simply building large prospect lists.

For example, if an SEO platform helps users identify backlink opportunities but doesnt provide a way to actually purchase or execute those placements, you should be able to identify how Link Publishers can potentially fill that gap through an API integration.

2. Build White-Label Partnerships

Identify companies that want to offer link-building services to their customers without building their own publisher network or fulfillment infrastructure.

The goal is to position Link Publishers as their backend link-building partner while they continue selling the service under their own brand name.

Potential partners may include:

1/ SEO agencies
2/ Digital marketing agencies
3/ SaaS companies
4/ SEO platforms
5/ Content marketing platforms
6/ Reseller businesses
7/ Enterprise SEO service providers

You will understand their existing business model and propose a white-label partnership that makes commercial sense for both companies.

3. CXO & Decision-Maker Outreach

Identify and connect with relevant decision-makers, including:

Founders, Co-Founders, CEOs, CMOs, Heads of SEO, Heads of Partnerships, Product Heads, Business Heads, and other senior stakeholders.

The role requires thoughtful outreach rather than sending generic templates.

Before contacting a prospect, you should understand:

What does their company do Where can Link Publishers fit What value can we add Who is the right person to approach What should the partnership proposal look like

4. Personalized Email Outreach

Strong email writing is one of the most important requirements for this position.

You should be able to research a product and write a personalized email explaining exactly how an API integration or white-label partnership could benefit their business.

We are not looking for generic emails such as:

"We provide link-building services and would love to explore a partnership."

Instead, outreach should demonstrate that you have understood the prospects product and identified a genuine integration opportunity.

Emails should be concise, personalized, commercially relevant, and written to generate conversations with senior decision-makers.

5. Partnership Discussions & Closure

Once a prospect shows interest, you will own the partnership conversation from initial discussion to closure.

This includes:

1/ Understanding the partners requirements
2/ Conducting discovery calls
3/ Presenting relevant API/white-label solutions
4/ Coordinating product demonstrations
5/ Discussing commercial models
6/ Coordinating technical discussions with internal teams
7/ Following up with stakeholders
8/ Managing NDA/documentation requirements
9/ Moving opportunities toward integration and launch

You do not need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable understanding how APIs work from a business and product perspective.

What Were Looking For

Experience: 3 5 years in Partnerships, Business Development, SaaS Sales, Strategic Alliances, API Partnerships, SEO SaaS, or a similar role.

The ideal candidate should have:

1/ Strong understanding of SaaS products and online business models.
2/ Good understanding of SEO and link building.
3/ Ability to research and understand new products independently.
4/ Ability to identify API integration opportunities.
5/ Experience communicating with founders and CXO-level stakeholders.
6/ Excellent written English and email communication.
7/ Strong personalization and cold outreach skills.
8/ Ability to convert product research into a compelling partnership proposition.
9/ Confidence conducting discovery and partnership calls.
10/ Strong follow-up and relationship-management skills.
11/ Commercial mindset and ability to think beyond traditional sales.

Technical Understanding

You do not need to code for this role.

However, you should understand basic concepts such as:

API integrations, SaaS platforms, data exchange, product integrations, white-label solutions, marketplaces, and reseller models.

You should be able to communicate a potential integration use case clearly enough for product and technical teams to take the discussion forward.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured simply by the number of emails sent.

We will primarily look at the quality and business impact of partnerships generated, including:

Relevant companies identified Decision-makers contacted Qualified partnership conversations API/White-label opportunities Commercial discussions Signed partnerships Successful integrations

The objective is to build long-term distribution and technology partnerships that allow Link Publishers inventory and link-building capabilities to reach customers through other products and brands.

About Link Publishers

Link Publishers is a link-building marketplace that connects businesses, agencies, and SEO professionals with publishers across multiple industries and markets.

Through our API and white-label solutions, partners can integrate link-building capabilities into their own products or offer link-building services under their own brand while Link Publishers supports the inventory and fulfillment from the backend.

We are looking for someone who can identify where these partnerships make sense and turn those opportunities into scalable business relationships.

About Amtech

Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise.

With Vista s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem.


Role Description

Amtech is seeking a Senior Performance Test Engineer who can independently own the non-functional quality of applications throughout the software development lifecycle. This role is responsible for designing, developing, executing, and analyzing performance tests to ensure applications meet performance, scalability, reliability, and availability goals under expected and peak workloads.

The Performance QA Engineer will collaborate closely with Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, Product Management, and Quality Engineering teams to identify performance risks early, diagnose bottlenecks, and drive performance improvements before production releases. The ideal candidate combines strong performance engineering expertise with solid software testing fundamentals, automation skills, and experience using AI-assisted testing tools to improve productivity and quality.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Performance Strategy and Planning

  • Define performance testing strategies for On-Prem and SaaS Products; business workflows, and enterprise systems.
  • Define performance strategies, non-functional requirements, SLAs, workload models, and release criteria.
  • Participate in requirement, architecture, database, infrastructure, and design reviews to identify performance risks early.
  • Design and execute baseline, load, stress, spike, endurance, scalability, capacity, volume, failover, and resilience tests.
  • Develop reusable scripts using JMeter, k6, Gatling, Locust, LoadRunner, NeoLoad, or similar tools.

Performance Analysis & Optimization

  • Analyze response time, throughput, latency, concurrency, error rates, and resource utilization.
  • Identify bottlenecks across the UI, APIs, application, database, network, infrastructure, and cloud layers.
  • Evaluate browser and frontend performance, including page load, rendering, responsiveness, and network activity.
  • Perform SQL performance analysis covering execution plans, indexing, locking, blocking, waits, I/O, and connection pooling.
  • Correlate logs, APM data, database metrics, infrastructure telemetry, and distributed traces to determine root causes.
  • Partner with Development, DevOps, Database, Infrastructure, and Architecture teams to recommend and validate optimizations.
  • Produce clear performance reports highlighting findings, trends, risks, and improvement recommendations.

Automation & Continuous Performance Testing

  • Build reusable performance testing frameworks and utilities.
  • Integrate performance testing into CI/CD pipelines for continuous performance validation.
  • Automate baseline, regression, and benchmark performance tests.
  • Define performance quality gates and produce clear reports with risks, trends, and recommendations.
  • Lead performance-related RCA and mentor teams on performance engineering practices.
  • Validate horizontal and vertical scalability, autoscaling, application stability, system capacity, and infrastructure sizing.

Quality Engineering & Continuous Improvement

  • Perform API, database, integration, and end-to-end validation to support comprehensive performance testing.
  • Validate application stability, reliability, and resilience under long-running, high-volume, and peak workload conditions.
  • Contribute to resilience, failover, recovery, compatibility, accessibility, and security testing initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Quality Engineers, Developers, Architects, and DevOps teams to ensure comprehensive functional and non-functional test coverage.
  • Lead root-cause analysis of production performance issues, recurring bottlenecks, and performance regressions, and drive corrective and preventive actions.
  • Establish performance baselines, monitor performance trends across releases, and proactively identify performance regressions before production deployments.
  • Track, analyze, and report key performance quality metrics, including response time, throughput, error rates, resource utilization, scalability trends, and capacity metrics.
  • Leverage approved AI tools for performance test generation, workload modeling, log analysis, result interpretation, defect investigation, and performance optimization.
  • Mentor Quality Engineers on performance engineering best practices and promote a performance-first quality mindset across teams.
  • Represent Performance Engineering in architecture reviews, technical design discussions, and release readiness reviews, providing evidence-based recommendations on system performance and scalability.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
  • Typically 5-8 years of Quality or Performance Engineering experience, including 3+ years in performance testing.
  • Strong experience with JMeter, k6, Gatling, Locust, LoadRunner, NeoLoad, or equivalent tools.
  • Strong knowledge of workload modelling, scalability, capacity planning, reliability, and performance analysis.
  • Experience testing on-premises, SaaS, cloud, hybrid, distributed, and enterprise applications.
  • Strong understanding of HTTP, REST APIs, WebSockets, caching, messaging, and asynchronous processing.

title: AI and Cloud Security Engineer
jobDescription:
Overview
The AI & Cloud Security team is chartered to make that vision operational. We are seeking senior technical owner of the AI security runtime control plane and detection fabric. You will build and integrate the inline enforcement pipeline (AI gateway runtime data protection intent-based enforcement), tune the policies that keep it fast and low-friction, and serve as the final escalation point for the most complex AI and cloud security incidents. You will also help implement and participate in operation of a closed-loop defensive system in which continuous red-team findings automatically improve runtime policies, detection logic, and SOC threat models. You join a team of two AI & Cloud Security Architects and will be the engineering force that turns strategy into operating controls across a multi-cloud estate (Azure, AWS, GCP).
This role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the security of AI and cloud environments, AI applications and infrastructure, addressing potential threats, and maintaining compliance with regulatory standards. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in AI technologies and their implementation as well as cloud security, security principles and cybersecurity best practices. The ability to develop automation in both AI and cloud environments with infrastructure as code (IaC) or policy as code principles is required. The engineer will report to AI & Cloud Security leadership and have strong working relationships with IT and application development leadership.
Responsibilities
  • Integration build and own the AI runtime control plane. Engineer, deploy and operate the inline enforcement pipeline for AI traffic: an AI gateway chained with runtime data-protection and intent-based enforcement platforms, fronting LLMs, tools, and MCP servers across Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex, Copilot Studio, Databricks, and self-hosted environments.
  • Harden the gateway layer for resilience : configure buffering and overload management, enforcement timeouts on external-processing filters, layered global/local rate limiting, and prompt-truncation filters to defend against token-exhaustion and "reasoning overload" denial-of-service attacks.
  • Integrate the wider AI security ecosystem into one coherent system : onboard AI asset-intelligence context (agent inventory, ownership, blast radius) into enforcement decisions; connect model-security and supply-chain telemetry and continuous red-team signals into SIEM correlation and SOC workflows; stream unified AI detections, decision logs, and policy events for forensics and audit.
  • Policy tuning enforce without friction. Author and calibrate runtime policies: prompt-injection and jailbreak prevention, PII detection/redaction and data masking, intent-based filtering, tool-call validation, MCP access control, and agent permission boundaries (including "lethal trifecta" prevention for low-code agents). Balance detection versus hard-block modes to minimize false positives, and tune per AI archetype embedded SaaS copilots, democratized low-code agents, homegrown agentic pipelines, device-based coding agents, and homegrown models.
  • Operate the closed loop : translate continuous adversarial-testing findings into runtime policy updates, new detection content, and guardrail tuning, then validate remediation through re-testing so defenses evolve with attackers rather than remaining static.
  • L3 coverage final escalation for the AI Security toolset. Lead deep investigations of AI-specific attacks (direct/indirect prompt injection, RAG poisoning, memory poisoning, agent hijacking, MCP/tool abuse, model manipulation, AI-driven data exfiltration), perform decision-replay forensics and root-cause analysis, drive automated containment (agent quarantine, permission revocation, kill switch) toward our sub-15-minute containment objectives, and mentor L2 analysts. Troubleshoot any incidents related to policies.
  • Evaluate and pilot AI security vendors : run structured proofs-of-concept for runtime defense, AIDR, AI-SPM, AI red-teaming, and model-security platforms, and provide technical recommendations as the stack matures.
  • Engineer and operate cloud security controls across Azure, AWS, and GCP posture policies, detection tuning, and remediation of misconfigurations, excessive entitlements, and workload risks, including the Kubernetes estates (AKS/EKS) hosting the AI gateway layer.
  • Design and maintain secure multi-cloud patterns consistent with company approved architectural blueprint as well as zero-trust agent access: least-privilege identity for humans, service principals, and agents (Entra ID, AWS IAM, GCP IAM, PAM), conditional access for AI platforms, and least-privilege OAuth scopes for agent integrations.
  • Embed security into DevSecOps: Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) scanning, container/Kubernetes security, secrets management, CI/CD hardening, and pre-deployment AI security testing gates in Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions.
  • Support cloud workload vulnerability management (VMs, containers, registries, serverless) with risk-based prioritization, and act as escalation point for investigations spanning cloud, identity, endpoint, and AI telemetry.
Critical Skills
  • Proven ability to integrate enterprise security platforms into one system : API/connector engineering, log ingestion and normalization, SIEM/SOAR integration, and multi-vendor inline architectures.
  • Strong AI/GenAI security depth : LLM and agentic-AI threat models (OWASP LLM Top 10 2025, OWASP Agentic Top 10, MITRE ATLAS), prompt-injection/jailbreak defense, RAG security, AI guardrails and gateways, MCP security, and the AI-SPM/AIDR/AI-red-teaming tooling categories. Hands-on experience with AI security technologies is highly valued; so is experience with open-source AI security tooling.
  • Multi-cloud security engineering across Azure, AWS, and GCP: CSPM/CWPP/CNAPP operations, cloud identity and entitlements, Kubernetes and container security, and secure architecture (hub-and-spoke, segmentation, baseline protection).
  • Proficiency in KQL, PowerShell, and Python for automation, detection engineering, and tooling; DevSecOps and IaC security (Terraform); CI/CD pipeline integration.
  • A pragmatic, enablement-first security mindset: comfortable with a default-allow culture where controls must be fast, precise, and low-friction rather than restrictive.
  • Excellent English communication clear runbooks, integration documentation, and the ability to explain trade-offs to architects, engineers, and leadership across a globally distributed team and multiple time zones.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Experience
  • Significant hands-on engineering responsibility, including in cloud security (Azure/AWS/GCP) and demonstrable experience securing or operating AI/ML or LLM-based systems (or strongly evidenced, rapidly acquired hands-on AI-security capability).
  • Proven track record deploying, integrating, and tuning security platforms in complex enterprise environments and serving as an L3 / senior escalation point; experience running vendor proofs-of-concept is a plus.
  • Experience operating security tooling in Kubernetes-based environments (AKS/EKS) and integrating open-source components into enterprise stacks is an advantage.
  • Relevant certifications strengthen an application (none individually required): CISSP, CCSP, SC-100, AZ-500, AWS Certified Security Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer; AI red-team or AI-security credentials are a plus.

jobDescription:
Role & responsibilities :

We are looking for a GCP Cloud Platform Engineer with strong hands-on experience in Google Cloud Platform, Pub/Sub, Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Cloud Build, Python and SQL.


Were Hiring | GCP Cloud Platform Engineer – MBSE
Job ID: MBSE Global Cloud Platform Requirement – 1
Experience: 4–6 Years
Location : Chennai
CTC: As Per Right Candidature
Domain: Automotive / Engineering / MBSE
Role: GCP Cloud Platform Engineer

The candidate will work on cloud migration, distributed job orchestration, AI/ML training pipelines and scalable cloud infrastructure supporting engineering simulation workloads.


1. Distributed Systems & Messaging Concepts
This is the most critical conceptual domain knowledge, separate from just "knowing the Pub/Sub API":

At-least-once delivery semantics understanding that messages can be delivered more than once, and why your worker code needs to be idempotent (i.e., safe to run twice without corrupting data)
Ack deadlines and lease extension since FEA jobs can run long, the candidate needs to understand how to extend acknowledgment deadlines for long-running tasks (otherwise Pub/Sub will think the worker died and redeliver the job to someone else)
Dead-letter queues knowing how to design a "graveyard" queue for jobs that fail repeatedly, so bad jobs don't loop forever
Ordering guarantees (or lack thereof) Pub/Sub doesn't guarantee message order by default, so if job sequencing matters at all, they need to know how ordering keys work
2. GCP-Specific Infrastructure Knowledge
IAM & service accounts — Pub/Sub and Vertex AI both rely heavily on fine-grained permissions; candidate should know how to scope service accounts securely (principle of least privilege) rather than granting broad access
Terraform provider quirks for GCP — the google Terraform provider has specific resource types for Pub/Sub topics/subscriptions and Vertex AI that behave differently than generic cloud resources
Networking basics (VPC, firewall rules) — especially if worker workstations are on-prem/local and need secure connectivity to GCP resources
3. Container & CI/CD Domain Knowledge
Docker fundamentals — building lean, reproducible training containers
Cloud Build pipeline syntax and triggers — knowing how to wire up automated builds tied to Git pushes or version tags
Vertex AI-specific packaging conventions — Vertex AI Custom Jobs expect containers to follow certain conventions (entrypoints, environment variables like AIP_MODEL_DIR, etc.)
4. Cross-Language Integration Knowledge (the unusual one)
MATLAB-to-GCP interoperability — this is a genuinely rare skill. Most cloud engineers have never touched MATLAB. Candidate should know either:
MATLAB's limited native GCP support, or
How to call GCP REST APIs / gRPC directly from MATLAB when no SDK exists
This is worth flagging as a "nice to have but rare" — you may need to accept a candidate who is strong on the Python/Pub/Sub side and pair them with someone who knows MATLAB, rather than expecting one person to have both.
5. Light Domain Knowledge of FEA / Engineering Simulation Workflows (Optional but valuable)
They don't need to be an FEA engineer, but understanding basics like:
Why FEA jobs can run for a long time and vary a lot in duration (which affects ack-deadline and autoscaling design)
The nature of "design info" as structured/large input files (which affects how you'd design message payloads — likely passing references/pointers to storage rather than raw data through Pub/Sub, since Pub/Sub has message size limits)
This helps them make smarter architecture decisions (e.g., knowing Pub/Sub messages are capped at 10MB, so large FEA design files should live in Cloud Storage with just a reference/URL passed in the message)
6. ML/AI Training Pipeline Knowledge
Basic ML training workflow concepts — checkpointing, distributed training, GPU utilization — to make good decisions about Vertex AI machine types and scaling
Vertex AI's job specification format — different from Cloud Run Jobs' YAML/config structure, so familiarity with translating one into the other is valuable

Candidate has to undergo scripting test in SQL during interview.



Preferred candidate profile :


Pub/Sub Migration (Job Orchestration)
• Redesign our current BigQuery-based job orchestration system (jobs table with lease/complete state transitions, driven by frequent small DML updates) into a Pub/Sub-based work-queue architecture
• Rework existing Terraform-managed infrastructure to provision Pub/Sub topics, subscriptions, IAM, and dead-letter handling
• Update local worker client code (Python and MATLAB) to consume from Pub/Sub instead of polling BigQuery
• Design for idempotency and safe handling of redelivery/ack-deadline edge cases given long-running FEA jobs
• Address MATLAB's lack of native Pub/Sub SDK support (e.g., via REST/gRPC integration)
Vertex AI Migration (AI Training Pipeline)
• Migrate an existing containerized Python training pipeline from Cloud Run Jobs to Vertex AI (Custom Training Jobs) to resolve compute scaling limitations
• Set up Vertex AI infrastructure and Cloud Build CI/CD pipelines for containerized training jobs
• Port existing training codebase with minimal disruption, resolving environment/resource-spec differences between Cloud Run and Vertex AI

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
jobDescription:
As a Senior AI/ML Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and implementing sophisticated AI-powered solutions and GenAI applications. You will work hands-on with Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks, and cloud-native AI tools to deliver intelligent, scalable, and secure enterprise solutions. You will play a key role in designing and delivering highly scalable, next-generation AI products within our Agentic Systems. Collaborating closely with AI Architects, Cloud Engineers, and Product Owners, you will build and deploy AI services that transform business processes and enhance user experiences in the healthcare domain.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and deliver high-performant, scalable, and well-documented AI products and applications.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and innovation in building next-gen agentic systems.
  • Identify performance/scalability hotspots in applications and implement effective resolutions.
  • Write well-documented code with comprehensive test automation that meets agreed design and quality criteria.
  • Design and develop robust RESTful APIs to serve AI models.
Collaboration & Management
  • Collaborate with AI Architects and cross-functional teams to translate solution blueprints into implementable modules.
  • Participate actively in technical discussions, design reviews, and sprint planning to ensure smooth agile delivery.
  • Support project managers by helping define realistic timelines and technical dependencies.
  • Maintain high-quality documentation for AI models, APIs, and data pipelines.
  • Contribute to Proofs of Concept (POCs) and internal accelerators to showcase new AI capabilities.
  • Evaluate and recommend third-party tools, APIs, and frameworks for AI adoption within our enterprise systems.
Mentorship & People
  • Perform peer code reviews and guide other team members to elevate the teams overall technical competency.
  • Support peer learning through internal demos, technical discussions, and collaborative problem-solving.
  • Share best practices in AI coding standards, prompt design, and data preparation.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Education: Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience: Minimum 5 years of proven software development experience, including building machine learning or data science solutions.
AI/GenAI Expertise: Hands-on knowledge of RAG, Prompt Engineering, and Agentic frameworks.
  • Programming: Strong proficiency in Python for service development.
  • Database & Architecture: Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, data modeling, and modern containerization/orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Cloud Computing: Strong knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including virtualization, hosted services, multi-tenant infrastructures, storage systems, and CDNs.
  • Data Engineering: Knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ETL technical architectures, infrastructure components, and reporting/analytic tools.
  • AI Productivity: Experience utilizing AI productivity tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot).
  • Soft Skills: Strong debugging, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills. Ability to work independently, drive workstreams, and deliver high-quality outcomes. Excellent customer-facing communication and listening skills.
Mandatory Tech Stack
  • Programming: Python
  • AI/ML Frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers, OpenAI API, Azure OpenAI, or Anthropic API
  • LLM Expertise: Experience with GPT, Claude, Llama, Mistral, or other open-source LLMs
  • RAG Frameworks: Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, or Weaviate
  • Cloud AI Platforms: AWS Bedrock, Azure Cognitive Services, Google Vertex AI
  • APIs & Integration: REST APIs, Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman
  • Data & Storage: MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, or Vector databases
  • DevOps/MLOps: Git, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins)
  • Testing: PyTest, Postman, API-level testing
  • Version Control: Git/GitHub, Bitbucket
  • Agentic Workflows: Familiarity with LangGraph or CrewAI.
  • Optimization: Experience with prompt optimization, model evaluation, and basic knowledge of transformer architecture internals.
  • Methodology: Strong Agile delivery experience.
  • Healthcare Industry Experience: Highly preferred and considered a strong bonus! Familiarity with healthcare data, compliance, and workflows.
  • Data Pipelines: Experience working with modern workflow orchestration tools like Airflow.
  • Governance: Awareness of responsible AI practices and model governance principles.

title: Senior Software Engineer - AI
jobDescription:
Role Summary
We are hiring Senior Engineers who combine solid software engineering fundamentals with proven proficiency in AI-assisted development. This role is designed for engineers who have actively used AI coding tools (such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI only) for at least one year and can leverage these capabilities to ship higher-quality code faster. You will be embedded in product engineering squads, leading feature development, mentoring junior engineers, and championing AI-first development practices across the team.

What Makes This Role Different

This is not an AI research role - it is a core engineering role for engineers who use AI as a force multiplier. We expect you to:
  • Use AI coding assistants daily to accelerate development without sacrificing code quality.
  • Critically evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security vulnerabilities, and maintainability.
  • Share best practices for AI-assisted workflows with the broader engineering team.
  • Help define team standards for responsible and effective AI tool adoption.
Key Responsibilities

1 Feature Engineering Delivery
  • Design, build, and ship production-quality features across the full stack or within your domain (backend, frontend, platform, or data).
  • Leverage AI coding assistants to write, refactor, document, and test end-to-end code efficiently.
  • Translate product requirements and technical specifications into clean, maintainable implementations.
  • Lead feature squads for medium-complexity initiatives from design through deployment.
  • Participate in and drive sprint planning, backlog grooming, and technical estimation sessions.
2 AI-Augmented Development Practices
  • Champion the use of AI pair-programming tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude, etc.) across the engineering org.
  • Develop and document internal guidelines for effective AI prompt engineering within coding workflows.
  • Conduct training sessions or knowledge-share presentations on maximising productivity with AI tools.
  • Critically audit AI-generated code for logic errors, security issues, and performance anti-patterns before merging.
  • Stay updated on the latest AI development tooling and evaluate new tools for team adoption.
3 Code Quality Engineering Excellence
  • Write testable, modular, and well-documented code following the teams style guides and design principles.
  • Drive test-driven development (TDD) and maintain code coverage targets.
  • Perform thorough code reviews with constructive feedback; uphold engineering standards.
  • Identify and address technical debt proactively; contribute to architecture improvements.
  • Participate in RCA (root cause analysis) for production incidents; implement lasting fixes.
4 Architecture Technical Design
  • Contribute to system design discussions, proposing solutions with appropriate trade-off analysis.
  • Create and maintain technical design documents (TDDs), ADRs (Architecture Decision Records), and API contracts.
  • Evaluate and adopt relevant third-party libraries, APIs, and SaaS tools with a security-first mindset.
  • Collaborate with platform / DevOps teams on observability, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code.
5 Mentoring Team Growth
  • Mentor 1 2 mid-level engineers; conduct regular 1:1 technical coaching sessions.
  • Onboard new team members by sharing codebase context, tooling setup, and team practices.
  • Contribute to a culture of psychological safety, learning from failures, and continuous improvement.
6 Cross-functional Collaboration
  • Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Operations to deliver delightful, high-quality user experiences.
  • Coordinate with data and AI/ML teams to integrate model endpoints, APIs, and AI features into product surfaces.
  • Participate in customer-facing escalations where deep technical expertise is required.
Required Qualifications
1 Education
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Candidates without a degree but with a strong portfolio and demonstrable project history will be considered.
2 Experience
  • 3 5 years of professional software engineering experience in a product-focused environment.
  • Minimum 1 year of active, hands-on experience using AI coding tools in professional work (not just personal projects).
  • Track record of shipping production features end-to-end with measurable business impact.
3 Technical Skills Core Engineering
  • Languages: Proficiency in at least one of Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Go, or Kotlin.
  • Web / API: REST, GraphQL, gRPC; familiarity with microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Databases: SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, DynamoDB).
  • Cloud: AWS, GCP, or Azure compute, storage, serverless, and managed services.
  • DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI); IaC basics (Terraform/Pulumi).
  • Testing: Unit, integration, and e2e testing frameworks; TDD/BDD familiarity.
  • Version Control: Git, branching strategies (GitFlow, trunk-based), PR workflows.
4 AI Tooling Skills (Mandatory)
  • Demonstrated proficiency with at least one AI coding assistant (Cursor IDE, Claude Code, Codex CLI).
  • Ability to craft effective prompts for code generation, refactoring, debugging, and documentation tasks.
  • Experience reviewing and validating AI-generated code for correctness and security.
  • Understanding of limitations of LLM-based coding tools (hallucinations, context window, license risks).
5 Nice to Have
  • Contributions to open-source projects.
  • Experience building or integrating AI/ML features (e.g., calling LLM APIs, embedding models, RAG pipelines).
  • Familiarity with agentic coding frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI).
  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment with rapid iteration cycles.
  • Knowledge of web security (OWASP Top 10, secure coding practices).
Behavioural Competencies
  • AI-First Mindset: Naturally reaches for AI tools to accelerate tasks while maintaining engineering rigour.
  • Ownership: Takes end-to-end accountability from design to deployment to monitoring.
  • Pragmatism: Balances perfect with shipped; knows when to iterate vs. over-engineer.
  • Mentorship: Invests in the growth of peers and junior colleagues.
  • Communication: Writes clearly (code comments, docs, Slack) and articulates trade-offs confidently.
  • Curiosity: Continuously explores new tools, languages, and architectural patterns.
  • Collaboration: Works well in cross-functional squads; builds trust quickly.

Candidates must hold a CCNP focused on routing and switching and a CWNA, with CWNE preferred. The ideal candidate has at least 4 years of experience, hands-on Ekahau wireless survey and design expertise, and Cisco ISE experience in enterprise environments.

About the Role
Ataris technology team spans infrastructure, DevOps, IT operations, and multiple engineering teams, with many initiatives running in parallel. A large part of this role is keeping that portfolio coordinated: holding the full picture of everything in motion, keeping parallel threads aligned and moving, and building the AI and automation that make this possible at scale. Technical leads own the delivery of their own teams work; this role complements them by holding the view across teams, connecting dependencies, and keeping shared goals aligned so the portfolio moves forward as a whole.
This is a hands-on, ownership-driven program management role with a strong emphasis on AI and automation. It suits someone who takes ownership of outcomes, brings order to complexity, and is energised by keeping many moving parts on track. Success comes through influence, credibility, and follow-through rather than formal authority.
Responsibilities
  • Take end-to-end ownership of assigned programs and be accountable for their delivery outcomes.

  • Track team goals and objectives, monitor progress against them, and keep each team aligned to the outcomes that matter most. Distinguish real progress from activity, and validate reported status through informed questioning.
  • Work with tech leadership to help resolve what is blocking progress and help resolve miscommunication and misalignment between teams.
  • Run the departments operating rhythm as a decision-making forum, ensuring each review concludes with clear owners, decisions, and deadlines that are followed through to closure.
  • Keep Technology and its business and executive stakeholders aligned on scope, priorities, and expectations, translating between technical and business audiences, surfacing concerns early, and communicating issues together with a recommended path forward.
  • Prepare executive updates and decision-ready briefs covering situation, options, recommendation, and the decision required, demonstrating the value Technology delivers in terms the business understands.
  • Design and build automation that reduces manual coordination and reporting work, treating the operating rhythm itself as a system to be engineered and continuously improved.
  • Apply AI tooling to convert meeting transcripts into action items, identify themes across ticket queues, summarise lengthy discussion threads, and draft updates and briefs.
  • Automate status reporting by integrating Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, and Slack or Teams, including early detection of schedule slippage, risk flagging, and proactive reminders to owners ahead of milestones.
  • Build and maintain KPI dashboards for each team covering delivery health, operational performance, and progress against goals, using metrics that reflect genuine improvement rather than volume of activity.

About the India Design Studio

We are establishing an India Design Studio in Gurugram to support Inizio Ignites global teams. The studio will operate as a central design hub, working with business-unit spokes across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and Innovation Growth.

The Design Studio will turn complex strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear, persuasive client stories. Our goal is to improve the quality, speed and consistency of these materials; strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise; and build reusable design assets and ways of working that support client delivery and growth.

How quality works in the studio

Quality is shared. Everyone who creates or edits work is accountable for the accuracy and quality of their contribution. Designers complete a structured self-check before handover. The Production QA Assistant provides independent, checklist-based review and delivery control. The Senior Designer provides creative oversight and final design sign-off for priority or high-risk work. Business stakeholders remain accountable for factual content, client requirements and final business approval.

How we use AI

Approved AI and automation tools may be used to support brief understanding, content structuring, asset discovery, layout exploration, tagging and quality checks. They are enabling tools rather than substitutes for design craft. Human judgement, confidentiality, accessibility, brand integrity and final accountability always come first.

Your primary role

Designer - India Design Studio

This role is a developing presentation designer who delivers high-quality, client-facing work within agreed standards and timelines. You will improve the clarity, structure and visual impact of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks and related materials, while building the judgement and independence required to progress in the team.

What you will do

  • Design and redesign slides, proposal sections, RFP materials, credentials and case studies to improve clarity, visual hierarchy, structure and readability.
  • Apply Inizio Ignite brand standards, PowerPoint templates, visual systems and document standards consistently.

tagsAndSkills: adobe creative cloud,client delivery,ai,concurrent,craft,business development,case studies,iconography
jobDescription:
About the India Design Studio

We are establishing an India Design Studio in Gurugram to support Inizio Ignites global teams. The studio will operate as a central design hub, working with business-unit spokes across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and Innovation Growth.

The Design Studio will turn complex strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear, persuasive client stories. It will support high-value business development and client-facing work, including proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority materials.

Our goal is to improve the quality, speed and consistency of these materials; strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise; and build reusable design assets and ways of working that support client delivery and growth.

How quality works in the studio

Quality is shared. Everyone who creates or edits work is accountable for the accuracy and quality of their contribution. Designers complete a structured self-check before handover. The Production QA Assistant provides independent, checklist-based review and delivery control. The Senior Designer provides creative oversight and final design sign-off for priority or high-risk work. Business stakeholders remain accountable for factual content, client requirements and final business approval.

How we use AI

Approved AI and automation tools may be used to support brief understanding, content structuring, asset discovery, layout exploration, tagging and quality checks. They are enabling tools rather than substitutes for design craft. Human judgement, confidentiality, accessibility, brand integrity and final accountability always come first.

Your primary role

Designer - India Design Studio

This role is a developing presentation designer who delivers high-quality, client-facing work within agreed standards and timelines. You will improve the clarity, structure and visual impact of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks and related materials, while building the judgement and independence required to progress in the team.

What you will do

  • Own the design and delivery of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority client-facing materials.
  • Translate strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear visual narratives, page structures, diagrams and data stories.
  • Develop credible visual options based on the audience, content maturity, client context and available time.
  • Manage multiple assignments independently, clarify briefs with business stakeholders and flag scope, timing or quality risks early.
  • Apply and reinforce Inizio Ignite brand standards, templates, accessibility requirements and final-file standards.
  • Provide constructive craft feedback and practical support to Designer 1 colleagues, while escalating priority creative decisions to the Senior Designer.
  • Own the quality of your work, complete the studio self-check and resolve issues identified through creative review or independent QA.
  • Create and refine reusable templates, slide components, visual systems, iconography and data-visualisation patterns.
  • Maintain clean, editable, accessible, correctly named and version-controlled files that support reliable handover and future reuse.
  • Use approved AI tools responsibly to accelerate understanding, exploration and production, while ensuring every output is accurate, appropriate and human-reviewed.
  • Contribute to studio standards, onboarding materials, knowledge capture and continuous improvement.

About you

Your skills and experience

  • Around 4+ years of experience in presentation design, visual design, production design or a related creative role, ideally in healthcare, life sciences, consulting, professional services or an agency environment.
  • A strong portfolio showing polished client-facing presentation work, visual storytelling, slide redesign, data visualisation and alternative creative approaches.
  • Advanced PowerPoint skills and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma or similar tools; charting experience would be advantageous.
  • Strong command of layout, typography, hierarchy, information design, brand application and final-file quality.
  • Ability to work directly with stakeholders, challenge unclear briefs constructively and manage expectations across several concurrent requests.
  • Experience giving useful craft feedback or supporting the development of less-experienced designers.
  • Practical AI literacy and the judgement to evaluate AI-assisted outputs critically and responsibly.
  • High attention to detail, strong prioritisation and confidence working under time pressure without compromising core quality standards.
  • Ideal profile
  • You can move comfortably between fast-turn production work and more considered visual storytelling.
  • You take ownership, communicate clearly and know when to involve the Senior Designer or business stakeholder.
  • You enjoy helping others improve and contributing to shared standards, assets and ways of working.
  • You are motivated by the opportunity to shape a new Design Studio and strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise.

Ideal profile

  • You enjoy turning rough or inconsistent content into clear, polished and client-ready materials.
  • You can work confidently within templates while bringing creativity, clarity and visual thinking.
  • You seek feedback, learn quickly and take increasing ownership as your skills develop.
  • You are collaborative, dependable and motivated to help build a new global design capability.

Career progression

This role sits within the Design Studio career framework of Production QA Assistant, a Design team and Senior Designer. Progression to the next level is based on stronger independent ownership, visual storytelling, stakeholder management, delivery of more complex work and contribution to studio standards - not tenure alone.

Further information

This is a full-time role and is expected to follow a hybrid working pattern, based at our Inizio location in Gurugram. The role will support global teams across time zones, so flexibility to work within agreed UK- and US-aligned collaboration windows may be required. The exact reporting line, working pattern and hours will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

Wolters Kluwer is seeking a Lead Enterprise Software Engineer to design and drive the evolution of enterprise-scale platform engineering capabilities, leveraging Infrastructure as Code, AI-augmented engineering practices, and automation at scale.

Leadership & Enablement

  • Drive BIM governance and platform alignment.

  • Enable Digital Twin and intelligent engineering initiatives.
  • Standardize engineering platforms and collaboration models globally.

Enterprise Platform Architecture

  • Provide architecture leadership across Finance, Procurement, HR, ERP, Project Delivery, Engineering, and Corporate platforms.
  • Drive platform modernization and transformation initiatives.
  • Ensure interoperability across enterprise systems.
  • Maintain enterprise-wide application standards and governance.

Integration Architecture

  • Define enterprise integration strategy.
  • Establish API-first and event-driven architecture principles.
  • Define middleware and integration platform standards.
  • Ensure seamless integration across business-critical platforms.
  • Drive reusable and scalable integration patterns.

Data Architecture Governance

  • Define enterprise data architecture.
  • Establish master data ownership and governance.
  • Drive data quality, stewardship, and lifecycle management.
  • Enable enterprise reporting, analytics, and business intelligence.
  • Ensure trusted and consistent data across business domains.

AI, Automation Digital Innovation

  • Define enterprise AI architecture and governance.
  • Lead Microsoft Copilot strategy and implementation governance.
  • Establish Responsible AI principles.
  • Govern AI, machine learning, and automation solutions.
  • Enable intelligent business services and digital innovation.

Cloud Technology Platform Strategy

  • Establish architecture standards for SaaS, cloud, and hybrid platforms.
  • Drive platform resilience, scalability, and cost optimization.
  • Lead cloud governance and FinOps practices.
  • Ensure high availability and disaster recovery readiness.

Application Management Services (AMS) Governance

  • Define enterprise application support and operational governance standards.
  • Ensure seamless transition from project delivery to operational support.
  • Establish support models, service KPIs, and operational controls.
  • Drive continuous service improvement and automation.
  • Reduce application incidents, support costs, and operational risks.

Security, Risk Compliance

  • Govern identity, access management, and platform security standards.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory, client, and corporate requirements.
  • Support Zero Trust and enterprise cyber-security initiatives.
  • Partner with security teams to maintain an audit-ready technology landscape.

Vendor Technology Governance

  • Govern strategic technology partnerships and vendor roadmaps.
  • Lead software asset management and licensing optimization initiatives.
  • Ensure vendor solutions align with enterprise standards.
  • Drive commercial optimization and technology value realization.

Leadership Stakeholder Management

  • Partner with business leaders, engineering leaders, finance leaders, HR leadership, and technology teams.
  • Influence strategic technology decisions at executive level.
  • Lead architecture communities and technical governance forums.
  • Mentor architects and develop enterprise architecture capabilities.
  • Build a culture of innovation, governance, standardization, and operational excellence.

Experience, Education and other Required:

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, Digital Transformation, or Technology Leadership roles.
  • Experience governing large-scale enterprise application portfolios.
  • Experience leading complex business and technology transformation programs.
  • Experience working across engineering, business, corporate, and digital platforms.
  • Experience operating in global, multi-vendor environments.
  • Experience balancing strategic transformation with operational excellence.

title: Sr. Business Development Representative
jobDescription:
About the Role

As a Senior Business Development Representative, you will play a pivotal role at the front of the sales function by building a high-quality pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting. Working closely with UK-based Account Executives, you will identify, engage and qualify prospective customers, ensuring opportunities are effectively handed over for continued progression.

This is a high-activity role focused on personalised outreach, pipeline generation and maintaining excellent data quality. You will collaborate on account strategy and messaging, continuously refine outbound approaches, and contribute directly to the growth of the business through consistent execution and strong commercial awareness.

Responsibilities

  • Own LinkedIn outbound by running targeted, personalised outreach to CTOs, Heads of Engineering and senior stakeholder buyers.
  • Build a qualified sales pipeline by researching and engaging in-ICP accounts and booking qualified meetings for the UK Account Executive team.
  • Partner closely with UK Account Executives on account strategy, messaging and seamless meeting handover to ensure no opportunities are lost.
  • Conduct first-touch qualification using MEDDPICC principles to identify genuine customer challenges before handing meetings to the Account Executive team.
  • Achieve activity and outcome targets through consistent daily outreach, strong connection and reply rates, and qualified meeting bookings.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in HubSpot and manage outbound sequences using tools such as HeyReach, Smartlead and Clay/Apollo.
  • Continuously test and optimise outbound messaging and sequences to improve reply rates and conversion performance.

Requirements

  • Industry experience would be a great advantage, with a background in staff augmentation / tech talent as a service, and an understanding of the model, the buyer and the objections.
  • Alternatively, strong experience in tech recruitment and staffing outbound or SDR, with the ability to open a retained, long-term relationship rather than a one-off placement.
  • Alternatively, B2B SaaS or technology SDR/BDR experience selling to CTOs, Heads of Engineering and senior technical buyers.
  • An experienced outbound prospector, ideally LinkedIn-led, within B2B technology or talent.
  • Comfortable prospecting into CTOs, Heads of Engineering and senior technical buyers.
  • An excellent written communicator in English, with a natural, human outbound style, not "spray and pray".
  • Highly organised and able to manage high volume without dropping quality.
  • Familiar with MEDDPICC qualification principles.
  • Self-starting, resilient and target-driven, with the ability to work UK hours alongside a UK-based team.

Benefits

  • Uncapped commission and a clear path to promotions.
  • Fully remote within India, working closely with a London-based team.
  • Generous holiday leave
  • The chance to build your sales career inside a scaling business with global ambition.

We are looking for a Business Analyst to work closely with an Agentic AI engineering team delivering intelligent, workflow-driven AI solutions. jobDescription:
We are hiring a Data & Intelligence Analyst to own our data work end to end: getting hold of the data we need, turning it into clean and reliable datasets, producing the analysis, and delivering the reports and dashboards our clients commission.

This is a hands-on ownership role, not a support-only one. You will be given the question that matters. From there it is yours: work out where the data lives, go and get it, make it trustworthy, work out what it says, and deliver it as something a senior decision-maker can act on. You own the method, the definitions, the quality, and the finished product.

The bar is high. This work goes in front of senior people who will ask exactly how each number was produced, and you need to be able to answer.

Your core advantage is that you work fluently with AI. You use AI tools not as a novelty but as the way you operate: to gather, classify and analyse data, to move faster, and to produce more, better. That fluency is central to the role.

This is a fully remote role. We are open to candidates based anywhere.

Working hours
Monday to Friday: 9am to 6pm UK time.
Saturday: 9am to 1:30pm UK time.

The Role: AI-Native, used centrally throughout

You will:

  • Define exactly which records are in scope for each piece of analysis, source them from licensed data providers, APIs and public sources, and verify how much of the intended set you actually managed to capture before you rely on it.
  • Acquire supporting data from wherever it exists: public registers, official statistics, published datasets, international government sources, and formal information requests.
  • Assemble everything into clean, structured, reliable datasets, including the unglamorous work of reconciling the same entity appearing under four different names across four different sources.
  • Normalise high volumes of inconsistent free-text values into a clean, consistent and defensible set of categories, and keep that mapping stable over time.
  • Work out what the data implies where it does not state it directly, inferring what you need from the fields you do have. Document the method and measure how often it is right.
  • Own the classifications and definitions: how records map to categories, how comparison groups are defined, how each metric is calculated. Keep them stable so this quarter's analysis is comparable with the last one.
  • Define every metric precisely and stand behind it. Where a figure is directly observed, say so. Where it is estimated, build the model, document it, validate it against external benchmarks, and label it on the output.
  • Own the end-to-end production of our client-facing reports, from raw data to a finished, polished document, delivered inside the committed window.
  • Produce the analysis, the comparisons and the charts, and write the interpretation and recommendations that go with them: concise, evidence-led, and in plain English a busy reader understands in thirty seconds.
  • Handle the awkward realities of large record-level datasets: missing fields, inconsistent naming, partial dates, duplicates, and knowing when a small sample cannot carry a percentage.
  • Explain and defend your methodology when someone challenges it, including its limitations, honestly.
  • Build and maintain our recurring datasets and tracked indicators, refreshed to a calendar, so the picture is always current rather than assembled in a panic.
  • Compare data across different countries and reporting systems, and know when two numbers that look comparable are not.
  • Specify the dashboard versions of our products precisely enough for our engineers to build them: the data model, the filters, the comparison logic, and the refresh cycle.
  • Turn each piece of work into a repeatable process. The second time should be much faster than the first, and the tenth should be close to routine.
  • Use AI across the whole workflow to work faster and better than a traditional analyst.
  • Flex onto other data work across the business when needed, from marketing and funnel analysis to commercial modelling and market research.

The work spans everything the business needs evidence for, wherever a sharp and reliable analyst is most useful. You are the person who makes sure the data exists, the numbers are right, the method is defensible, and the finished product is excellent.

What we're looking for

  • 2 to 6 years in a data, analytics or research role where you owned an analytical output and delivered it to someone who relied on it, not just supported someone else's reports.
  • You go and get data rather than waiting for it. You have worked with datasets you had to assemble yourself, not only ones that were handed to you clean.
  • Genuinely good with data: you can take a large, messy, inconsistent dataset and make it tell the truth.
  • Comfortable with data far too large for a spreadsheet. Working SQL and/or Python, and strong in Excel.
  • Experience with large record-level datasets, including data licensed from third-party providers, and the judgement to work out whether a provider's coverage is genuinely what they claim.
  • Experience classifying and standardising messy real-world data, for example mapping thousands of free-text values into a clean set of categories.
  • Comfort working out what a dataset implies where it does not say so explicitly, and honesty about the error rate when you do.
  • Strong data visualisation: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or an AI-built equivalent. Whatever you use, you produce a clear, polished result and can explain exactly why you chose that view.
  • Excellent written English, with the ability to turn analysis into a clear, concise piece of writing that reads as yours. This is essential and will be assessed.
  • Good judgement about certainty. You define your metrics before you calculate them, you know the difference between a real finding and a coincidence, you label estimates as estimates, and you will not let a number ship that you cannot defend to someone who challenges it.
  • Genuine, demonstrable fluency with AI tools as a core part of how you work, with concrete examples, not just "I use ChatGPT sometimes".
  • Strong ownership: you take an ambiguous problem, work out the steps yourself, and come back with a finished answer rather than a list of questions.
  • Organised and reliable: commissioned work runs to a deadline and recurring work runs to a schedule, and you hit both.
  • Comfortable working fully remote.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a role where the core task was assembling a target list or dataset from third-party and public sources, for example market mapping, competitive intelligence, or data enrichment for sales or marketing.
  • Experience collecting data from web sources and APIs.
  • Experience building a benchmarking product, an index, a scoring model, or any analysis that compares organisations against a peer set.
  • Experience evaluating and buying third-party data.
  • Experience with public records research, freedom of information requests, or government and official statistics sources.
  • A statistics or economics background, or a track record of self-taught rigour.
  • Comfort with marketing and funnel data, or with commercial and financial modelling.
  • Building automations and data pipelines (Python, SQL, n8n, or AI-driven workflows).
